title: Gastly Is 0.1 Kilos of Trouble
premise: Gastly weighs 0.1 kilograms, yet its Pokédex says it can topple an Indian elephant in two seconds.
audiencePromise: Compare Gastly's tiny weight with its gas body, then reveal the weakness that keeps its threat balanced.
openLoop: How can something weighing 0.1 kilograms topple an elephant?
payoff: Gastly turns a shapeless gas body into a threat against any size, with wind as its weakness.
engagementQuestion: Overwhelming threat or fragile gas cloud?

voice.instructions: Speak quickly, warmly, and clearly. Stress the contrast between Gastly's tiny weight and enormous threat. Pause briefly before the two-second reveal, then sound thoughtful on the final choice.

scenes.headline: 0.1 KILOS. ELEPHANT DOWN.
scenes.narration: 0.1 kilos. Elephant down in two seconds.
scenes.caption: TINY BODY. HUGE THREAT.

scenes.headline: THERE'S NOTHING TO GRAB
scenes.narration: Gastly has no real shape because its body is gas.
scenes.caption: A BODY MADE OF GAS

scenes.headline: ANY SIZE CAN BE ENVELOPED
scenes.narration: That lets it envelop an opponent of any size.
scenes.caption: LARGE OR SMALL, IT CAN SURROUND THEM

scenes.headline: INDIAN ELEPHANT. TWO SECONDS.
scenes.narration: Then the target gets specific: an Indian elephant, in two seconds.
scenes.caption: THE POKÉDEX SETS A COUNTDOWN

scenes.headline: WIND CAN ERASE THE THREAT
scenes.narration: But strong wind can quickly blow its gaseous body away.
scenes.caption: POWERFUL, BUT FRAGILE

scenes.headline: POWERHOUSE OR GAS CLOUD?
scenes.narration: Overwhelming threat or fragile gas cloud?
scenes.caption: WHICH ONE IS GASTLY?
